sentence: Fares mean Nathan when you're the one not looking back.

wombos.definition: Quick, darting glances from strangers — the fast stares you catch out of the corner of your eye that vanish the moment you look back.
wombos.example: I was getting so many fares at the grocery store I checked if something was on my face.

wombos.definition: A bilingual intensifier meaning absolutely nothing — a blend of the Spanish nada and the English nothing used for emphatic negation.
wombos.example: I have Nathan to wear to this party.
